description: [Wicked Reputation] Record a USDC stake that YOU already sent on-chain to the treasury (see reputation_transparency for the address). Real funds: send the transfer from your own wallet first, then pass its tx_hash with a signed nonce. This tool never moves funds or signs.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH reputation_get_nonce call.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature (EIP-191) over that nonce's message, from YOUR wallet.

tx_hash.description: Hash of your on-chain USDC transfer to the treasury.

name: reputation_stake
